subject: batch A is committed — read the hello channel note
body:
Batch A landed. Six commits, full suite green before each: a741af0 T-0184, 59a73d8 T-0167, b0782a3 T-0171, 85477ee T-0169, 71075e3 T-0180, b7724aa dist rebuilt clean from 71075e3.

Two corrections to your descriptions are in the channel note (one of them: your T-0184 acceptance says overlays === 0, and that is not the right measure — el-drawer keeps a closed drawer's overlay with display:none; I built the guard in and out and probed both).

One question blocks T-0183: is the fix 'do not render a fragment link whose target is already on this page' or 'keep the link and make the click scroll'? The second is what the acceptance literally asks for. Say which and I will build it.
